name: Cold Embrace
description: Seals a unit within %cast_range% tiles in ice for %duration% turns, making it immune to attacks. Each turn the ice deals %dmg_heal% damage to an enemy, or heals an ally for the same amount.
details: A sealed unit is fully disabled for the duration, unable to move or act.

upgrade.summary: A sealed ally can still walk, though it cannot attack or cast.
details: A sealed enemy is fully disabled for the duration, unable to move or act.
A sealed ally keeps its movement, but is silenced and disarmed until the ice melts.
